texts.en:
WARNING: Blocks access to ['concept_psionic_ascension'].

This civilization's ancestors were plagued by otherworldly forces that invaded the mind, inspiring them to dedicate great effort and resources into developing anti-psionic technology.

Their ancient devices are still functional, but remain untested against psionic threats from the wider galaxy.

sections.zh:
我们先祖留下来的记录讲述了一场摧毁[GetHomeWorldName]的灵能瘟疫。超自然的力量攻击心智，毁灭性的辐射散布在大气中——而这都是[GetSpeciesAdj]社会中的灵能尝试引起的。

为了应对这些威胁，先祖们建造了远古堡场来抵御入侵心智的力量。仅依靠日常维护，这座古老的建筑就已经强大到足以保护所有[GetSpeciesNamePlural]免受灵能干扰的威胁，它的核心技术也为其他心灵防御的发展提供了信息。

随着我们的文明准备扬帆越过[capital_scope.System.GetName]的轨道，等待我们的只有未知。在我们陌生的世界里又有什么样的灵能威胁在等待着我们呢？
sections.en:
The records of our ancestors tell of a psychic plague that once devastated [GetHomeWorldName]. Otherworldly forces attacked their minds, and destructive radiation was diffused throughout the atmosphere - all encouraged by psionic practitioners from within [GetSpeciesAdj] society.

In response to these threats, our ancestors built the Ancient Ward to protect against mind-invading forces. With only routine maintenance, this venerable structure has proven strong enough to defend all [GetSpeciesNamePlural] from the threat of psionic influence, and its core technology has informed the development of other defenses of the mind.

As our civilization prepares to voyage beyond the orbit of [capital_scope.System.GetName], we are faced with the unknown. What psychic threats might lurk beyond our ken?

texts.zh: 就在我们试图与他们取得联系时，舰桥乘员突然感到了间歇性头痛……
texts.en: As we attempt to make contact, our bridge crew suffers intermittent pangs of head pain...

texts.zh: 尽管反复尝试，[exiled_country.GetName]依旧没有回复我们的通讯。
texts.en: Despite repeated attempts, the [exiled_country.GetName] are not responding to our communications.

texts.zh:
我们用于压制灵能的远古堡场正在发出异常的读数。这通常是来自[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的灵能活动激增的结果，但我们并没有找到任何这种堕落行为的迹象。

那么答案也许就藏在我们的国境内。长距离遥感影像显示[exiled_system_border.GetName]系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与远古堡场发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。
texts.en:
Our psi-suppressive Ancient Ward is producing irregular readings. This would normally result from spikes in psionic activity on [Root.GetHomeWorldName], but we have found no evidence of such depravity.

The answer may lie beyond our borders. Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, which correlates with the erratic measurements of the Ancient Ward.

texts.zh:
新探索到的[from.GetName]恒星系中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。[root.GetName]的船员遭受到了一系列精神症状：情绪波动；令人衰弱的精神压力；反复出现难以形容的恐怖景象。他们的舰队系统也发生了怪异的故障。

这些现象与我们祖先记录的体验非常相符；非常有可能就是他们所说的“灵能辐射”，一种极具破坏力的能量发射形式。在远古堡场的保护不到的[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上，我们第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系。在更彻底评估其影响之前，我们强烈反对派遣任何舰船深入。
texts.en:
An alarming situation is developing in the newly explored [from.GetName] system. The crew of the [root.GetName] is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror. Their fleet's systems are also experiencing strange, erratic malfunctions.

These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission. Outside of the protection of the Ancient Ward on [owner.GetHomeWorldName], we are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered the source of these dangerous emissions to be the nearby [exiled_center_system.GetName] system. Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.

texts.zh:
[root.GetName]的船员们岌岌可危。

在[from.GetName]恒星系里暴露到这种极高等级的灵能辐射后，他们开始产生比此前报道的更糟糕的精神压力。舰队的系统也受到严重故障的困扰，妨碍了多数正常的功能。

长程扫描表明有更高等级的辐射在从[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系中释放出来。在更彻底评估其影响之前，我们强烈反对派遣任何舰船深入。
texts.en:
The crew of the [root.GetName] is in danger.

Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the [from.GetName] system, they began experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

Long-range scanners indicate even higher levels of radiation in the nearby [exiled_center_system.GetName] system. Sending any of our vessels deeper is strongly discouraged until we evaluate its effects more thoroughly.

texts.zh:
出乎意料的是，[This.System.GetName]恒星系中存在许多似乎是由智慧生物所建造的大型物体。我们为了了解其创造者，将其代称为[This.ContactCountry.GetName]，并尝试在保持安全距离的前提下进行直接的沟通工作。

该恒星系内所有的生命形式必然都处在我们探测到的高水平灵能辐射的威胁下。
texts.en:
Astonishingly, the [This.System.GetName] system appears to contain a number of large objects that appear to be of intelligent construction. We might learn more about their creators, code-named [This.ContactCountry.GetName], by attempting direct communications from a safe distance.

Any life forms in the system must be in great danger from the high levels of psi-radiation we detected.

texts.zh:
进一步的研究确定在[This.System.GetName]恒星系中的物体是一艘外星飞船，但我们还未与任何船上人员建立任何沟通渠道。

特使[exiled_envoy.GetName]汇报[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的团队开始遭受到超心灵学症状的困扰，包括[This.System.GetName]上出现奇特生物的无法解释的幻象。尽管有这些问题，我们的特使还是坚持投入[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]的这项任务。
texts.en:
Further study has confirmed the objects in the [This.System.GetName] system to be alien spacecraft, though we have yet to make contact with any of the vessel's occupants.

Troublingly, envoy [exiled_envoy.GetName] reports that [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team has begun suffering from parapsychological symptoms, including unexplained visions of strange beings present in [This.System.GetName]. Despite these concerns, our envoy remains steadfast in [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] dedication to the mission.

texts.zh:
在数个月的寂静后，我们收到了一份来自[exiled_envoy.GetName]的通讯。这位通常冷静而直率的特使发来了一份离奇而混乱的报告。[exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap]杂乱无章地描述了一些奇怪的意象——显然是纠缠在一起的梦境和幻觉。[exiled_envoy.GetHisHer]团队的所有人也都一样神志不清。

目前他们已经解除了职务，该任务也无限期搁置了。无论[This.System.GetName]里的到底是什么东西，目前我们都暂时没有办法安全地调查。
texts.en:
After months of silence, we received a transmission from [exiled_envoy.GetName]. Usually sober and direct, the envoy gave a bizarre, muddled report. [exiled_envoy.GetSheHeCap] submitted rambling descriptions of strange imagery - apparently a tangle of dreams and delusions. No member of [exiled_envoy.GetHisHer] team proved to be any more coherent.

They have been relieved of their duties, and this mission has been suspended indefinitely. Whatever presence is in [This.System.GetName], it is currently beyond our means to safely investigate.

texts.zh:
悬浮在翻滚的水流之上。是[Root.Capital.GetName]，还是……？

……呼叫……

水面扭转着分开。恶臭的瘴气从无底的深处喷涌而出。

……回复……没有……

无休无止。令人窒息。

这太糟糕了。
texts.en:
Suspended above the roiling current. [Root.Capital.GetName], or...?

...calling...

The surface twists open. A fetid miasma belches from unseen depths.

...answer...nothing...

Ceaseless. Suffocating.

It is terrible.

[Root.GetHomeWorldName]中一种令人警惕的情况正在酝酿。大众正在遭受一系列精神症状：情绪波动；令人衰弱的精神压力；反复出现难以形容的恐怖景象。

这些现象与我们祖先记录的体验非常相符；非常有可能就是他们所说的“灵能辐射”，一种极具破坏力的能量发射形式。那些在远古堡场保护之外的人第一次体验到了祖先所警惕的心智疾病。

在校准了我们的长程扫描仪探测了这种独特的能量形式以后，我们发现这些危险发射的来源是附近的[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系。尽管有风险，但是我们想彻底地学会如何保护自己，最好的办法就是接近现象的源头进行研究。
texts.en:
An alarming situation is developing on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. The population is suffering a range of psychological symptoms: emotional turmoil; debilitating mental stress; recurrent visions of unspeakable horror.

These phenomena closely match the experiences recorded by our ancestors; this is most likely what they referred to as 'psi-radiation', a particularly destructive form of energy emission. Those outside of the protection of our Ancient Ward are for the first time experiencing the mental blight that our forebears warned of.

After calibrating our long-range scanners to detect this unique form of energy, we discovered that these dangerous emissions spread from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.

texts.zh:
近处的灵能“感染”已经传播进了[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系中。

尽管有远古堡场提供保护，这种侵蚀导致我们在[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的人口也开始表现出可能与灵能辐射荼毒有关的一些症状了。预测显示，这种心灵瘟疫可能很快会传播至[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]，我们的母星也会因此受到进一步的威胁。

尽管有风险，但是我们想彻底地学会如何保护自己，最好的办法就是接近现象的源头进行研究。
texts.en:
The nearby psionic 'infection' has spread into the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Despite the protections offered by the Ancient Ward, this encroachment has caused our population on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] to experience mild symptoms suggestive of psi-radiation poisoning. Projections show that the mind-plague may soon expand into [Root.home_planet.System.GetName], where it will pose an even greater danger to our homeworld.

Despite the risks, our best hope of learning to protect ourselves more thoroughly is to study this phenomenon closer to the source.

尽管有风险，但是我们想彻底地学会如何保护自己，最好的办法就是接近现象的源头进行研究。

label.en: Let us learn to stop this infection.

texts.zh:
我们的研究者们在[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系内的剧毒灵能辐射中备受煎熬，但他们的任务带来的重要的发现。

我们将这种危险的现象归类为“灵能光环”，这是一种巨大破坏性能量的积聚体，它不仅会扰乱我们的思想，也能干扰我们的技术装备。它是从[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系传播而出，那里的灵能能量增长到能够跨越恒星系进行传播的强度了。

它已经沾染了[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]恒星系，造成了毁灭性的影响。[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的远古堡场只能提供有限的保护。
texts.en:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a 'Psionic Aura', a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

It has already reached the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system, where the effects have been devastating. The Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] only offers limited protection.

texts.zh:
我们的研究者们在[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系内的剧毒灵能辐射中备受煎熬，但他们的任务带来的重要的发现。

我们将这种危险的现象归类为“灵能光环”，这是一种巨大破坏性能量的积聚体，它不仅会扰乱我们的思想，也能干扰我们的技术装备。它是从[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系传播而出，那里的灵能能量增长到能够跨越恒星系进行传播的强度了。

如果它沾染上[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]恒星系，后果会是毁灭性的。[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上的远古堡场只能提供有限的保护。
texts.en:
Our researchers suffered greatly amid the poisonous psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, but their mission led to important findings.

We have classified this alarming phenomenon as a 'Psionic Aura', a vast accretion of destructive energy that disrupts not only our minds but our technology as well. It has spread from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system, where the psionic energies grew to such intensity that they expanded across star systems.

If it reaches our [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system, the effects would be devastating. The Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] only offers limited protection.

label.zh: 我们必须增强远古堡场。
label.en: We must strengthen the Ancient Ward.

texts.zh:
我们孜孜不倦的研究者们开发出了一种增强[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上远古堡场的方法。通过改进灵能衰减器，它的防护效果不仅可以覆盖到整颗行星，还能保护[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]系。

这项研究激发了在该失落的科技领域内更广泛的研究。我们现在知道灵能辐射和[Root.GetSpeciesAdj]意识之间存在着相互联系：不止是这种能量发射可以影响我们的精神状态，我们的精神状态也同样能影响灵能辐射等级。看来我们对“灵能”实践的古老禁忌是有科学依据的。
texts.en:
Our tireless researchers have developed a method for strengthening the Ancient Ward on [Root.GetHomeWorldName]. By enhancing its psionic attenuators, the protection can be extended to cover not only the whole planet, but the entire [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system.

This research has stimulated broader study into this lost technology. We now know that the link between psi-radiation and the [Root.GetSpeciesAdj] mind is reciprocal: not only can these emissions affect our mental states, but our mental states can influence psi-radiation levels. It would seem that our immemorial taboo against 'psionic' practices has a scientific basis after all.

texts.zh: 我们的宏伟堡场建好之后，[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。[Root.GetHomeWorldName]上，大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
texts.en: With our Grand Ward now complete, psi-radiation in the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system has been reduced to manageable levels. The population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName] is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

texts.zh: 随着我们宏伟堡场的完工，[Root.GetHomeWorldName]星系内的灵能辐射水平降低到了可控的范围之内。大众的各种症状逐渐缓解了过来。
texts.en: With our Grand Ward now complete, psi-radiation on [Root.GetHomeWorldName] has been reduced to manageable levels. The population is gradually recovering from its adverse effects.

texts.zh: 无论如何，这个灵能光环以及可能存在着的其他同类都依旧在荼毒着这个恒星系。我们的科学家认为，宏伟堡场的科技可以用于开发更强大的“虚境封印”。这些硕大无比的装置可以抑制一整个星团的光环。在[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系建造一个虚境封印将能大幅度提升控制灵能威胁的能力。
texts.en: Nevertheless, this Psionic Aura, and potentially others, still poisons the wider galaxy. Our scientists hypothesize that the technology of the Grand Ward could be applied to the development of a more powerful 'Shroud Seal'. These massive structures should be able to suppress Auras in entire star clusters. Building a Shroud Seal in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system will be a significant advancement in controlling the psionic menace.

label.en: This is research worthy of pursuit.

texts.zh: 自从暴露在极高等级的灵能辐射中之后，[exiled_system_border.GetName]星系内的[Root.GetName]船员就开始承受比以往报道都更加严重的心理压力。舰队的系统也受到严重故障的困扰，妨碍了多数正常的功能。
texts.en: Upon exposure to the extremely high levels of psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, the crew of the [Root.GetName] is experiencing even worse psychological distress than was previously reported. The fleet's systems are also beset by severe malfunctions, effectively neutralizing most normal capabilities.

texts.zh:
灵能光环已经散播进[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]系。灵能辐射荼毒的不良影响在整个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的人口中已经非常明显，我们舰船的功能也受到严重影响。

升级远古堡场已经比以往更加迫在眉睫了。
texts.en:
The Psionic Aura has spread to the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system. The adverse effects of psi-radiation poisoning are already evident throughout the population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName], and our ships' functionality is severely impaired.

The urgency of strengthening the Ancient Ward is greater than ever.

texts.zh:
灵能瘟疫已经传播到了[Root.home_planet.System.GetName]系。灵能辐射荼毒的不良影响在整个[Root.GetHomeWorldName]的人口中已经非常明显，我们舰船的功能也受到严重影响。

弄明白这种污染比以往更加迫在眉睫了。
texts.en:
The psionic blight has spread to the [Root.home_planet.System.GetName] system. The adverse effects of psi-radiation poisoning are already evident throughout the population of [Root.GetHomeWorldName], and our ships' functionality is severely impaired.

The urgency of understanding this contamination is greater than ever.

texts.zh: 我们失去了对母星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的控制。作为我们主要的知识储备地和所有社会活动的中心，如果不夺回它，我们将无法继续推进我们的反灵能事业。
texts.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

label.zh: 我们必须重新夺得控制权，片刻不能耽误。
label.en: We must regain control without delay.

texts.zh: 我们重新获得了母星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的控制权。[root.GetName]可以继续全力推动反灵能事业。
texts.en: We have regained control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. The [root.GetName] can resume anti-psionic endeavors in full force.

texts.zh:
我们的科学家们完成了对先进灵能压制科技的研发。现在可以在我们控制的任何一个殖民地内建造灵能抑制器来复现宏伟堡场的效果了。

然而，要在其他恒星系内控制灵能光环的传播，我们还需要建造一种被称为虚境封印的更加强大的装置。这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解灵能光环，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。

这项研究也证实了一个令人不安的理论：存在着一个被称为“虚境”的空灵领域！古代神秘文献中描述的那种灵能维度很有可能是真的。该理论认为，感性众生的认知活动可以使能量从虚境内传递到可观察现实中——这种过程就是灵能光环的一般性来源。

这意味着我们不仅仅只是在与宇宙的客观力量作斗争，而是与某种潜在的未知意图的可疑行为对抗。
texts.en:
Our scientists have completed the development of advanced Psionic Suppression technology. We can now replicate the effects of the Grand Ward on any colony under our control by building a Psionic Suppressor.

However, to control the spread of Psionic Auras in other systems, we will need to construct a more powerful device known as a Shroud Seal. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

This research has also given credence to a disturbing theory: an ethereal realm known as the 'Shroud', a dimension of psionic energy described in occult texts of old, appears to truly exist. The theory posits that the cognitive activity of sentient beings can cause energy to pass from the Shroud into observable reality - and this process is the root cause of Psionic Auras in general.

This means that we are not merely contending with objective forces of the universe, but potentially calculated actions of unknown intent.

label.en: So the 'Shroud' is real after all...?

texts.zh: 我们从[exiled_system_border.GetName]系之外接收到了一份意料之外的通讯。[exiled_country.GetName]莫名其妙地完全掌握了我们的语言和通讯系统。
texts.en: We are receiving an unexpected transmission from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. The [exiled_country.GetName] have inexplicably gained complete mastery of both our language and communication systems.

texts.zh: 我们从[exiled_system_border.GetName]系之外接收到了一份意料之外的通讯。[exiled_country.GetName]莫名其妙地完全掌握了我们的语言和通讯系统。
texts.en: We are receiving an unexpected transmission from beyond the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system. The [exiled_country.GetName] have inexplicably gained complete mastery of both our language and communication systems.

title.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特

texts.zh:
屏幕上的人物以一种稳定、催眠的节奏与人交流，不时会作很长时间的停顿。

遥远的邻居们，鉴于你们对直接接触不予回应，我们只好诉诸于粗糙的技术通信。

我是乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特，[exiled_country.GetName]的灵主。事态很紧急；原谅我的仓促。你们在[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系的装置正在影响我们光环的流动。我们暂且认为这种不可接受的局面只是你方的无心之过。

这种光环利人利己，应当照耀整个星系。为了证明你们对上上善道的承诺，我们要求你们立即拆除所谓的“虚境封印”。
texts.en:
The figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am Uk-Hogolath Scarat, Psiarch of the [exiled_country.GetName]. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities. Your device in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.

The aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called 'Shroud Seal'.

label.zh: 我们之前可没收到过什么通讯。
label.en: We received no prior communication from you.

texts.zh: 我们用真音和你们沟通。你们听到了，你们肯定能听到内心的传音。你们有这种天赋的，但你们选择了压制。
texts.en: We spoke with the true voice. Had you listened, you would have heard the call within. You have the gift, though you choose to suppress it.

label.zh: 这光环具有破坏性，是一种瘟疫。
label.en: The aura is destructive. A plague.

texts.zh: 你的理解有问题。光环是我们守护神赐予的神圣礼物。它能打倒一切带来毁灭之物。
texts.en: Your understanding is faulty. The aura is a sacred gift of our protector. It casts down that which seeks to destroy.

label.zh: 如果我们拒绝你们的要求呢？
label.en: What if we refuse your demands?

texts.zh: 损害光环者无论是谁，都要镇压。如果你们拒绝，我们就要被迫采取军事行动了。
texts.en: Whoever harms the aura must be subdued. If you refuse, we will be forced to take military action.

label.zh: 我们绝不会摧毁自己的遗产。
label.en: We will never destroy our heritage.
We agree to dismantle the Seal.

texts.zh: 愚昧的蠢货。
texts.en: Benighted fools.

texts.zh: 明智的决定。
texts.en: A wise decision.

texts.zh:
为了避免与[exiled_country.GetName]发生直接冲突，我们默认了他们对拆解[exiled_system_border.GetName]系内虚境封印的要求。

与那些散布灵能瘟疫的家伙们的接触已经在[this.GetName]引起了严重关切。移除虚境封印似乎也只能是一种暂时的绥靖政策。他们很定还会想要对我们的宏伟堡场做一样的事情的——这就是我们绝对不能接受的事情。

无论如何，一战在所难免。
texts.en:
In order to avoid immediate conflict with the [exiled_country.GetName], we acquiesced to their demands to dismantle the Shroud Seal in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system.

Exposure to those responsible for the psionic pestilence has caused grave concern throughout the [this.GetName]. Removal of the Shroud Seal is only likely to be a short term appeasement. They will eventually expect the same of our Grand Ward - and that is something we cannot accept.

In any case, future hostilities seem inevitable.

title.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特

texts.zh:
屏幕上的人物以一种稳定、催眠的节奏与人交流，不时会作很长时间的停顿。

遥远的邻居们，鉴于你们对直接接触不予回应，我们只好诉诸于粗糙的技术通信。

我是乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特，[exiled_country.GetName]的灵主。事态很紧急；原谅我的仓促。一座位于[capital_scope.GetName]的建筑正在影响我们光环的流动。我们暂且认为这种不可接受的局面只是你方的无心之过。

这种光环利人利己，应当照耀整个星系。为了证明你们对上上善道的承诺，我们要求你们立即拆除所谓的“宏伟堡场”。
texts.en:
The figure on screen communicates with a steady, hypnotic rhythm, punctuated by extended pauses.

Far neighbors, given your non-response to direct contact, we have resorted to the drudgery of crude techcomms.

I am Uk-Hogolath Scarat, Psiarch of the [exiled_country.GetName]. The matter is urgent; forgive the lack of formalities. A structure on [capital_scope.GetName] is inhibiting the spread of our auric flow. We assume this intolerable situation is the result of an ignorant mistake on your part.

The aura benefits all. It should shine throughout the galaxy. To demonstrate your commitment to the greater good, we demand the immediate dismantling of your so-called 'Grand Ward'.

label.zh: 我们之前可没收到过什么通讯。
label.en: We received no prior communication from you.

title.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特

texts.zh:
灵主的图像一出现，便开始冷漠地、无声地指责。

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我很失望还要打这通通讯。尽管你们已经同意拆除了虚境封印，但我们知道你们还在[capital_scope.GetName]维持这一座与之功能相似的建筑。你们的意图路人皆知。你们用行为证明了自己有多无知。你们对我们的光环流横加阻挠，对整个灵能事业无端蔑视，这都与整个跨星系的和平水火不容。我们别无选择。

等着见我们的舰队吧。
texts.en:
As soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission. Though you agreed to dismantle the Shroud Seal, we are aware that you have maintained a building on [capital_scope.GetName] with similar capabilities. Your intent is clear. Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.

label.zh: 这话该说给你们自己听。闭嘴吧。
label.en: You should do likewise. End transmission.

title.zh: 灵主乌克霍格拉斯·斯卡拉特

texts.zh:
灵主的图像一出现，便开始冷漠地、无声地指责。

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，我很失望还要打这通通讯。你们重建虚境封印的行为彻底浇灭了我们对救赎你们的一切期望。你们用行为证明了自己有多无知。你们对我们的光环流横加阻挠，对整个灵能事业无端蔑视，这都与整个跨星系的和平水火不容。我们别无选择。

等着见我们的舰队吧。
texts.en:
As soon as their image appears, the Psiarch launches into a cold, toneless rebuke.

[This.GetSpeciesNamePlural], I am disappointed to be making this transmission. Your rebuilding of the Shroud Seal has extinguished any hopes we had for your redemption. Your actions have confirmed your ignorance. Your disdain for our auric flow, and psionic betterment in general, is incompatible with intragalactic peace. We are left with no other choice.

Be prepared to meet our fleets.

label.zh: 这话该说给你们自己听。闭嘴吧。
label.en: You should do likewise. End transmission.

texts.zh:
随着巨大的灵能衰减器闪耀着启动，我们的虚境封印开始逐渐将灵能光环驱赶出[exiled_center_system.GetName]恒星系。

跨星系扫描确认了帝国领土的其他部分都直接通过超空间航道连接到[exiled_center_system.GetName]。只需要一座虚境封印就能打消整个[exiled_country.GetName]境内的灵能光环。

我们胜利的关键就在于保护封印了。
texts.en:
With its colossal psionic attenuators flared into action, our Shroud Seal is now in the process of driving out the Psionic Aura from the [exiled_center_system.GetName] system.

Interstellar scans have confirmed that the rest of our enemy's territory is directly connected to [exiled_center_system.GetName] via hyperlane. This single Shroud Seal is therefore capable of dissipating Psionic Auras throughout the entire territory of the [exiled_country.GetName].

Our victory hinges on the protection of the Seal.

texts.zh:
我们征服了[current_planet.GetName]上造成灵能威胁的殖民地。

我们了解到在该恒星系内出现的灵能光环受到了人口与虚境的心灵交互的增强。这些举措是由一群称为灵道会的精英灵能者们领导的。这个灵能邪教在宣导他们对所谓“超主”的忠诚，而这超主据称是虚境内一个强大实体，我们仅知道其被称为梦客。

他们的经文反复提到与这个存在有关的灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球[other_planet.GetName]上。找到这个东西就可以帮助我们阻止他们继续传播影响。
texts.en:
The colony of the psionic menace on [current_planet.GetName] has been conquered.

We have learned that the Psionic Aura present in this system was being amplified by the population's psychic interactions with the Shroud. These practices are led by a group of elite telepaths, the Assembly of Mindways. This psionic cult promotes devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud, known only as The Dreamer.

Their sacred texts make repeated mention of an artifact related to this being - apparently still extant on the planet [other_planet.GetName]. Acquiring this object will aid us in preventing further spread of their influence.

texts.zh:
我们完成了对[current_planet.GetName]的殖民，这曾是一颗[exiled_country.GetName]的行星。

从他们残留的记录中我了解到，该恒星系内此前存在的灵能光环是由人口和虚境的心灵互动造成的。带领这种行为的灵能邪教鼓吹诡异所谓的“超主”，据说是虚境里的一个叫做梦客的强大实体。

他们经文的残片中反复提到与这个存在有关的某件灵器——显然仍然存在于这颗星球[other_planet.GetName]上。要实现这个目标，就需要更慎重地征服[other_planet.GetName]，留下一部分人口。
texts.en:
We have completed our colonization of [current_planet.GetName], a former world of the [exiled_country.GetName].

From the remains of their records, we have learned that the Psionic Aura previously present in this system was caused by the population's psychic interactions with the Shroud. These practices were led by a psionic cult that promoted devotion to their 'patron', allegedly a powerful entity from within the Shroud known as The Dreamer.

Fragments of their sacred texts refer to an artifact related to this being, apparently still extant on the planet [other_planet.GetName]. Securing this object would require a more measured conquest of [other_planet.GetName], leaving some of its population intact.

texts.zh:
对[current_planet.GetName]的征服标志着我们对[exiled_country.GetName]的最终胜利。我们已立即对这些星球上的所有灵能活动进行了严厉打击，彻底消除了其可憎的灵能光环。

在该星球的主要城市里，矗立着一座名为梦客圣所的废弃高塔，它曾是前帝国现已声名狼藉的灵能邪教的至高神殿。我们的士兵形容它散发着一种神圣而令人不安的气息。

该建筑的最深处密室中，有一个密封严密的“茧”，散发出强大的局部灵能辐射。事实证明，标准弹药无法穿透其外部。要消除该物体对我们持续安全构成的潜在威胁，还需要进一步调查。
texts.en:
The conquest of [current_planet.GetName] marked our final victory against the [exiled_country.GetName]. We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable Psionic Aura.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the Sanctum of the Dreamer, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.

texts.zh:
在征服了[current_planet.GetName]之后，我们获得了曾经由一个名为[exiled_country.GetName]的帝国统治的领土。我们已立即对这些星球上的所有灵能活动进行了严厉打击，彻底消除了其可憎的灵能光环。

在该星球的主要城市里，矗立着一座名为梦客圣所的废弃高塔，它曾是前帝国现已声名狼藉的灵能邪教的至高神殿。我们的士兵形容它散发着一种神圣而令人不安的气息。

该建筑的最深处密室中，有一个密封严密的“茧”，散发出强大的局部灵能辐射。事实证明，标准弹药无法穿透其外部。要消除该物体对我们持续安全构成的潜在威胁，还需要进一步调查。
texts.en:
In conquering [current_planet.GetName], we gained control of territory once ruled by an empire known as the [exiled_country.GetName]. We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable Psionic Aura.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the Sanctum of the Dreamer, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.

texts.en:
In conquering [current_planet.GetName], we gained control of territory once ruled by psionic zealots. We have instituted an immediate crackdown on all psionic practices on these worlds, completely neutralizing their abominable Psionic Aura.

In the planet's principal metropolis lies a ruined tower known as the Sanctum of the Dreamer, once the high temple of the former empire's now-disgraced psionic cult. Our soldiers describe it as radiating a numinous, unsettling presence.

The innermost chamber of the structure houses a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating powerful levels of localized psi-radiation. Standard munitions have proven ineffective in breaching its exterior. Further investigation will be required to eliminate the potential threat this object poses to our continued safety.

label.zh: 令人不安的消息……继续调查。

texts.zh:
对[current_planet.GetName]上人口的彻底清除，标志着[exiled_country.GetName]帝国的终结。

初步调查显示，该星球上存在一个庞大的建筑网络，很可能是灵能浩劫的力量中心。如今，只剩下残垣断壁。

我们可能永远无法得知这些建筑曾隐藏着怎样堕落的秘密，也无法得知其居住者卑劣行径的真实性质。尽管如此，该星系现已清除其残余的灵能光环，使我们免受其曾造成的伤害。
texts.en:
The eradication of the population on [current_planet.GetName] marked the end of the empire known as the [exiled_country.GetName].

A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.

We may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its Psionic Aura, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.

texts.en:
The eradication of the population on [current_planet.GetName] marked the end of a devastating psionic threat.

A preliminary survey showed evidence of an extensive network of buildings on the planet, likely the power center of the psionic scourge. Now, only crumbling vestiges remain.

We may never know what degenerate secrets these structures housed, or the true nature of their occupants' craven practices. Nevertheless, the system is now cleansed of the last traces of its Psionic Aura, leaving us safe from the harm it once caused.

label.zh: 愿所有此类威胁都被消除。
label.en: May all such threats be vanquished.

texts.zh:
我们的研究者对[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]上的“茧”进行了全面的分析。

对这座宏伟建筑的外部扫描显示，它是一个专门设计用于容纳强大灵能实体的高规格安全容器。尽管该容器有重合金绝缘层，但高水平的灵能辐射还是透过外壳渗漏了出来。

茧的周围安装有一组灵能衰减器；激活的时候时，周边地区的所有人都受到了严重的神经损伤。

茧的表面随之扭曲，从卵型变成了不断变化的螺旋形。其上的孔穴洞窟，我们接到了来自内部的直接通信……
texts.en:
Our researchers conducted a thorough analysis of the 'cocoon' on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName].

External scans of this imposing structure revealed it to be a highly secure receptacle designed to contain a powerful psionic entity. Despite the container's insulative layers of heavy alloys, high levels of psi-radiation are permeating through the enclosure nonetheless.

A group of psionic attenuators were installed around the cocoon; when activated, everyone in the vicinity was struck with searing levels of neural distress.

The surface of the cocoon then twisted, its ovoid form becoming a shifting helix. The aperture has opened, and we are receiving direct communication from within...

texts.zh: 你听得到，但听不见。为什么？
texts.en: You hear, but do not listen. Why?

label.zh: 我们不会让你荼毒我们的心智的！
label.en: We will not let you poison our minds!

texts.zh:
荼毒？不是毒……

这是一首歌。唱歌就要先听见。敞开心扉，共享美好吧。
texts.en:
Poison? Not poison...

A song. To sing, you must listen. Let go of your self, and share its beauty.

texts.zh:
轮回飞转……我们倾听。

星辰飞旋……我们歌唱。
texts.en:
As the wheel spins... we listen.

As the stars spin... we sing.

texts.zh: 转个不停。在上面，也在下面。是被叫做“虚境”的和声。
texts.en: Ever-turning. Above and beneath. A harmony known as the 'Shroud'.

texts.zh: 我在……做梦。梦见了一首歌。但歌声沉默了。合唱声去了哪里呢？
texts.en: I am... dreaming. Dreaming of a song. But the voices have gone silent. Where did the chorus go?

label.zh: 把你关在这里的人走了。
label.en: The ones who kept you here are gone.

texts.zh: 你在这里。你会唱的……
texts.en: You are here. You might sing...

texts.zh:
是醒与梦之间的细流……是此方与彼方之间的道路。

你听不见……你们的心智无法理解……
texts.en:
A flow between waking and dreaming... A path between here and there.

You cannot hear them - your minds lack the understanding...

texts.zh: 我想听见歌声……但万籁俱寂……为什么？
texts.en: I want to hear singing... Everything is so quiet... Why?

label.en: What can you offer us in return?

texts.zh: 可以让你们看看……我的梦。星球的诞生。
texts.en: I can show you... my dreams. The making of worlds.

label.en: How do we know we can trust you?

texts.zh:
你只需听着。这首歌是真理，只因它的美。这是一首美丽的真理。

但你的心关着。可以敞开的。
texts.en:
You need only listen. The song is true because it is beautiful. A beautiful truth.

But your minds are closed. They can be opened.

texts.zh: 我还在这……听着两个世界的歌。但这边的一首失声了。
texts.en: I am there still... I listen to the songs of two worlds. This one is muted.

texts.zh: 你说的是真理。
texts.en: You speak truth.

texts.zh:
我们在[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]上发现的茧里寄宿着一个强大的异次元实体。它在某种意义上似乎就是威胁到我们心智健全的灵能光环的源头。

我们的灵能衰减器暂时减轻了它的危险，但目前还不清楚还能抑制它多久。如果能够妥善控制，我们甚至有可能利用它可怕的力量来实现自己的目的。

然而我们社会的多数人呼吁立即将其摧毁。这种东西光是存在就已经站在我们长久以来价值观的对立面上了。
texts.en:
The cocoon we discovered on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName] harbors a powerful interdimensional entity. It is likely that this being was somehow responsible for the Psionic Aura that threatened the sanctity of our minds.

Our psionic attenuators are mitigating the danger it poses for now, but it is unclear how long our devices can restrain its influence. It is possible that, under controlled circumstances, we can harness its terrible power for our own purposes.

Nevertheless, many in our society are calling for its immediate destruction. Its very existence stands against our long-held values.

label.zh: 想方设法利用这个……东西。
label.en: Find a way to make use of this... thing.

texts.zh:
思想穿透了灵能屏障。

我们听到了一段旋律，明亮但刺耳。

我们知道这种痛苦，强烈而熟悉。

你听见了。这梦是你的……唱吧，唱吧……
texts.en:
Thoughts penetrate our minds.

We hear a melody, bright and abrasive.

We know this pain, great and familiar.

You listened. The dream is yours... Sing, sing...

texts.zh: 我兑现了承诺。我为你们做了个梦。
texts.en: Just as I promised. I have dreamt for you.

texts.zh: 星球。新的星球，在我和你之间。
texts.en: Worlds. New worlds, between mine and yours.

label.zh: 这些星球对我们有什么用？
label.en: What use are these worlds to us?

texts.zh: 让我对它们歌唱吧。唱最明亮的歌。
texts.en: Let me sing to them. The brightest of songs.

texts.zh:
我们已经积累了大量关于虚境的知识，开发出了能抑制其恶劣影响的先进科技。在讨论如何将这种技术大规模应用到全星系的过程中，我们的舰队司令提出了一项有趣的提案。

他们建议将我们的一支舰队设立为一个独立的“灵督城邦”，这样就能向全星系的客户提供反灵能服务了。我们的前期投入将会用于建设一座空间站；而作为回报，我们可以获得其未来盈利的分红。他们的行动自由就能便于这类设施的大规模利用。

我们自然也能利用他们的服务——当然价格可以打折。
texts.en:
We have amassed great knowledge of the Shroud, and developed advanced technologies to suppress its pernicious effects. While debating how to apply this mastery galaxy-wide, our fleet commanders have put forward an interesting proposal.

They suggest setting up one of our fleets as an independent 'Mindwarden Enclave', which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.

texts.zh: [This.GetName]已经找到了一位适合创建我们第一个独立灵督城邦的候选者。如果审核通过，这支舰队将会在[This.Solar_System.GetName]设立一座新的设施，并立即开始提供反灵能服务。
texts.en: The [This.GetName] has been identified as a suitable candidate to form the basis of our first independent Mindwarden Enclave. If authorized, the fleet would establish a new facility in [This.Solar_System.GetName] and begin providing anti-psionic services forthwith.

texts.zh:
我们正在考虑将[This.GetName]设立为一座独立的“灵督城邦”以向整个星系提供反灵能服务。我们的前期投入将会用于建设一座空间站；而作为回报，我们可以获得其未来盈利的分红。他们的行动自由就能便于这类设施的大规模利用。

我们自然也能利用他们的服务——当然价格可以打折。
texts.en:
We are considering setting up the [This.GetName] as an independent 'Mindwarden Enclave', which would provide anti-psionic assistance throughout the galaxy. Our initial investment would fund the construction of a space station; in return, we would receive a share of future revenues. Their operational independence will allow for a larger-scale deployment of such facilities.

Naturally, we too could make use of their services - and receive back a cut of our own payments.

texts.zh:
与虚境以及灵能滥用的斗争让我们的人民变得更加强大，也更明确了我们的目标。第一座灵督城邦的建立正标志着一个康复和抵抗的新纪元。

在整个星系中，心智不再被灵能侵犯，所有星球都不再受到虚境力量的折磨。

这就是灵督时代。
texts.en:
Contending with the Shroud and the irresponsible use of psionics has strengthened our people and clarified our goals into sharper focus. The foundation of the first Mindwarden Enclave is the advent of a new age of healing and resistance.

Throughout the galaxy, no mind need be invaded by psionic aggressors, and no world tormented by forces from the Shroud.

It is now the age of the Mindwardens.

label.zh: 我们的旅程才刚刚开始

texts.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们新近的合约有了丰硕的成果。我们扩展了自己的民用业务，现在有好几个公司雇佣我们，让我们提供安保和维和服务。在合约期间，我们的特工碰巧找到了一些有价值的科学研究。你会在定期分红的末尾找到这些附加的内容。
texts.en: Esteemed Patron, our recent contracts have been fruitful. We have expanded our civilian operations, and several corporations have hired us for a variety of security and peacekeeping services. While on contract, our operatives chanced upon some valuable scientific research. You will find it attached along with your regular dividends.

texts.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，公司运营的很好，我们的收入一直在稳定的增加。以上是本次分红，此外我们还运来了一批额外的资源，这是我们从一个违约的民用客户手中扣押得到的。
texts.en: Esteemed Patron, the company is doing well, and our earnings are steadily increasing. Here are your dividends, along with an extra delivery of resources we recovered from a civilian client who defaulted on their payment.

texts.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们很高兴在这个财报周期宣告自己的利润突破了记录！鉴于此，我们很乐意在常规分红中加入一笔额外的丰厚提成。
texts.en: Esteemed Patron, we are pleased to announce record profits during this fiscal interval! As such, we have included a generous bonus to your regular dividends.

texts.zh: 尊敬的赞助者，我们最近的维和行动成功捣毁了几个海盗组织，我们收缴了一批数量极其丰厚的资源和科技数据。同你的常规分红一起，我们将这批战利品的大部分交付给你。
texts.en: Esteemed Patron, our latest peacekeeping operation had us dismantle several pirate operations and we recovered an extraordinary amount of resources and technological data. Most of these have been set apart for you, in addition to your well-earned dividends.

texts.zh:
我们初次涉入虚境导致其中的能量影响了可观测宇宙。这种影响尽管相当显著，但也相对零星孤立。“灵能光环”是将这种影响转变成持续流的一种方法。

随着我们的行为在虚境中回荡，与力量强大实体的距离也在缩短。如果我们获得了祂们的青睐，就能将祂们的灵能能量传导到现实世界中。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]认为，由此产生的“光环”可以强化我们的帝国，还能削弱对手——类似我们此前观察到的现象一样。
texts.en:
Our forays into the Shroud have caused its energies to affect observable space. Though significant, these effects have been intermittent and isolated. 'Psionic Auras' present a way to turn this influence into a constant flow.

Our actions ripple throughout the Shroud, drawing us closer to beings of great power. If we find favor with these entities, we might then channel their psionic energy into corporeal reality. Our [GetTelepathPlural] hypothesize that the resulting 'aura' would strengthen our empire, while weakening those that stand against us - just as we have previously observed.

texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出灵能光环的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 它被称为“灵能光环”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 由于我们与[fromfrom.GetName]的关系[GetLessThanRivalAdj]良好，我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
texts.en: Given our [GetLessThanRivalAdj]favorable relations with the [fromfrom.GetName], we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

texts.zh: 据[GetTelepathPlural]的说法，它能释放[GetBenevolentRivalAdj]的意志，因此我们预期它在我国境内的影响应该是[GetPositiveRivalAdj]的——只要我们和发出者之间的关系没有改变就是如此。
texts.en: According to our [GetTelepathPlural], it radiates [GetBenevolentRivalAdj] intent, so we expect its effects within our territory to be [GetPositiveRivalAdj] - as long as our relations with the emitter remain unchanged.

texts.zh: 我们是时候团结一致阻止灵能天灾了。
texts.en: Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

texts.zh: 如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

texts.zh:
严峻的时刻到了。尽管我们竭尽全力，轮回之终末还是到来了。它在群星之间四处恐怖地显灵……

我们是时候团结一致阻止灵能天灾了。
texts.en:
These are grave times. Despite our efforts, the End of the Cycle is upon us. Its dreadful manifestation stalks among the stars...

Now is the time for us to stand together and prevent a psionic apocalypse.

texts.zh:
你好。我谨代表[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

我们的使命是保护大家免受虚境以及所有传播其恶意效应者的威胁。我们信仰心灵神圣不可侵犯，巩固星系抵御灵能。

我们根据灵能传感器读数判断出你们不会造成这种威胁。太好了。我们很乐意提供帮助，保护你不受伤害。

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en:
Greetings. I speak to you as a representative of the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Our mission is to protect against the menace of the Shroud and all those who spread its ill effects. We believe in minds free from invasion, and a galaxy fortified against psionics.

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, you do not contribute to these threats. Excellent. We would be pleased to help you protect against anyone that does.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

texts.zh:
欢迎回来。[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

我们的灵能传感器读数清晰。你们没有被虚境玷污。很好，很好……

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en:
Welcome back. The [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] value our continued cooperation.

Our psi-sensor readings are clear. You remain unsullied by the Shroud. Good, good...

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

label.en: We would like to discuss Zro.
What can be done about Psionic Auras?

label.zh: 我们知道一个不错的灵能目标……
label.en: We know of a good psionic target...
We need help with £crime£ [GetCrimeDeviancy] among us.

label.zh: 我们可以借用你们的士兵。
label.en: We could make use of your soldiers.

label.zh: 你们愿意派一位督查来吗？
label.en: Would you be willing to send us a warden?

label.zh: 和我们说说轮回之终末。
label.en: We want to discuss the End of the Cycle.

label.zh: 作为你们的赞助方，我们有个提案。
label.en: As your founding patron, we have a proposal.

texts.zh:
抑制灵能光环主要有两种方法。

在行星上建造灵能抑制器可以逐渐减少整个恒星系的光环强度，并且防止进一步污染。

更强大的解决方法是虚境封印。这种复杂的机械可以逐渐消解灵能光环，直至完全抑制——生效范围包括其本身以及通过超空间航道直接相连的恒星系。
texts.en:
There are two principal methods of suppressing Psionic Auras.

Building a Psionic Suppressor on a planet will gradually reduce Aura intensity throughout the star system and prevent any further encroachment.

An even more powerful solution is a Shroud Seal. These sophisticated machines will gradually dissipate any Psionic Aura until it is suppressed entirely - in both the host system and those in direct connection via hyperlanes.

texts.zh:
乐意效劳。数据将会直接传过去。

愿这些科技在光环浩劫中给你带去和平。
texts.en:
Gladly. The data will be transmitted forthwith.

May these technologies bring you peace from the auric scourge.

texts.zh:
是这样吗？好吧，他们还在用灵能荼毒这个星系，我们就永远不得享受真的安宁……

有针对性的袭击可以表达我们对这种危险行为的反对。而在你们的经济支持下，我们愿意执行这次行动。

如果你们同意，就告诉我们目标吧。
texts.en:
Is that so? Well, we will never know true peace and security while they infect the galaxy with psionics...

A targeted raid would demonstrate our opposition to these dangerous practices. With your financial support, we are willing to conduct such an operation.

Let us know the target, if you agree.

texts.zh:
啊，好的。我们知道他们在实践灵能了。展示力量是正当的。

感谢你的支持。行动将会很快开始。
texts.en:
Ah, yes. We are aware of their psionic practices. A show of force is justified.

Thank you for your support. The operation will commence shortly.

texts.zh: 一支来自[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName]的军事舰队正在逼近我们的国境！拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。他们正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
texts.en: A military fleet from the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesName] is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. They are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

texts.zh: 一支来自此前未知的军事势力的舰队正在逼近我们的国境！拦截到的通讯表明他们受某个敌对势力雇佣来进攻我们的恒星系。他们自称[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural]，正在通过公开频道传递信息，直接通知了我们。
texts.en: A fleet from a previously unknown military power is approaching our borders! Intercepted communications indicate that they have been hired by a rival power to attack our systems. Identifying themselves as the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetSpeciesNamePlural], they are transmitting a message via an open channel, addressing us directly.

texts.zh:
棒极了。把泽珞委托给我们，可以对这种强大而被大规模滥用的物质进行关键的研究——这项研究将使整个星系受益。

这也是我们以高于星系标准的价格购买的原因。
texts.en:
Excellent. Entrusting us with zro enables crucial research into this powerful and widely abused substance - research that will benefit the whole galaxy.

This is why our rate for its purchase is well above the galactic standard.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 感谢你的贡献。
texts.en: Thank you for your contribution.

texts.zh:
那就让我们来提供一些有用的思想警察，这可以在[GetCriminalDeviant]意图演变成实际行为之前将其探测到。

他们使用一种专门开发的安全灵能替代方法，以科学技术来监测人群的认知活动。他们提供对精神状态的洞见，而不使用虚境的危险能量。
texts.en:
Then let us provide you with an effective Thought Police, which can detect [GetCriminalDeviant] intent before it manifests in actual behavior.

Their methods were developed as a safe alternative to psionic practices, using scientific techniques to monitor a population's cognitive activity. They provide insights on mental states without employing the dangerous energies of the Shroud.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 很好。我相信你会发现这种方法非常地有效。
texts.en: Excellent. I think you will find their methods quite efficacious.

texts.zh:
确实。通过合作我们发现了你们军事部署战略有一些可以改进的方面。

当然，我们这么说并不是有意侮辱；不过是术业有专攻罢了。如果你们能给出足够的价码，我们很荣幸能和如此有价值的客户就此合作。
texts.en:
Indeed. Our collaborations have already revealed to us some areas of improvement that could be made to your military deployment strategies.

We mean no insult by this, of course; we simply specialize in these fields. We would be honored to assist such a valued partner in this matter, should you provide us adequate compensation.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 很好。我们的舰队支援运作会立刻开始。
texts.en: Very good. Our fleet support operations will commence at once.

texts.zh:
您好，尊贵的合作伙伴。

我们的舰队后勤运作协助协议已经到期。如果您考虑的话，我们非常愿意继续合作。
texts.en:
Greetings, valued partner.

Our contract to assist in the logistical operations of your fleets has expired. We would be more than willing to continue this partnership, should you deem it worth your while.

texts.zh:
我们的灵督突击队是非常强大的震慑部队。他们有能应对各种威胁的装备，但对使用灵能的对手特别有效。

我觉得你会发现物有所值的。
texts.en:
Our Assault Wardens make excellent shock troopers. They are equipped to tackle diverse threats, but are especially effective against psionic opponents.

We think you will find them worth their price.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 你走运了；我们正好有一支连队准备好部署。就等着他们的运输船立即到达吧。
texts.en: You are in luck; we already have a company ready for deployment. Expect the arrival of their transport ship presently.

texts.zh:
我们非常乐意。

高效的领导是战胜虚境的关键，我们的督查们正精于利用严格的管理来压制灵能活动。
texts.en:
We would be more than willing.

Effective leadership is key to combating the Shroud, and our wardens are well-versed in suppressing psionic activity through firm governance.

label.zh: 我们还是考虑别的事情。

texts.zh: 明智的决定。愿他们的管理能保障你们的人民在未来的岁月里的安全。
texts.en: A wise decision. May their stewardship keep your population safe for years to come.

texts.zh: 说实话，这是个严峻的东西。星系中没有比轮回之终末更大的灾难了。
texts.en: A grave matter, indeed. There is no greater scourge in the galaxy than that of the End of the Cycle.

label.en: What is the End of the Cycle!?

label.zh: 我们要如何击败最终清算？
label.en: How can we defeat the Reckoning?

texts.zh: 愿你们对这场巨大威胁凯旋而归。它威胁到了居住在这个星系中的所有人的生死存亡。
texts.en: May you triumph against this great threat. It threatens the existence of everyone who calls this galaxy home.

texts.zh:
我们开发出了一种算法可以增强你们对最终清算的进攻能力。这可以提升你们武器系统在对特定灵能实体时的效率。

在目前阶段，这份代码的每次改进都需要大量重构，才能与各个军事基础设施兼容。因此，这是一项高级服务，但我们认为您能认可它的物超所值。
texts.en:
We have developed an algorithm that can augment your offensives against the Reckoning. It tunes your weapons' targeting systems for increased effectiveness against this specific kind of psionic entity.

In its current state, each deployment of the code requires extensive refactoring for compatibility with individual military infrastructures. This is therefore a premium service, but we think you will find it worth the outlay.

texts.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”

由于[root.GetHisHer]曾在内阁任职，[root.GetName]和[root.GetHisHer]雇员们的离开对政府运作造成了很大的干扰。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them."

Due to [root.GetHisHer] involvement on the Council, the departure of [root.GetName] and [root.GetHisHer] staffers has caused major disruptions to government operations.

texts.zh:
在我们对[FROM.GetName]发起进攻后，[root.GetTitle][root.GetName]离开了我们的国境。[root.GetHeSheCap]记录下了一段[root.GetHisHer]离开时的信息。

“你最近对灵督城邦的袭击不合情理。无论以何种身份，继续留在你的领土内工作，在道德和伦理上都站不住脚。我强烈建议你们停止这种毫无意义的敌对行动——但是，无论你们将来作何选择，我都不会留在这里坐以待毙了。”

万幸的是，除了搬离了[root.GetHisHer]自己的工作场所以外，[root.GetName]对领导层没有造成其他任何的扰乱。
texts.en:
Following our attack on the [FROM.GetName], [root.GetTitle] [root.GetName] has left our borders. [root.GetHeSheCap] recorded a message upon [root.GetHisHer] departure.

"Your recent attack upon a Mindwarden Enclave is unconscionable. Working within your territory, in any capacity, would be morally and ethically indefensible. I strongly recommend that you desist from these senseless hostilities - but, whatever your future choices, I shall not stay here to enable them."

Thankfully, aside from vacating [root.GetHisHer] workspace, [root.GetName] did not cause any other disruptions to leadership.

texts.zh:
我谨代表[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]与你通话。

根据我们灵能传感器的读数，整个[Root.GetName]已经无可挽回地被虚境玷污了。

你们的所作所为是在自掘坟墓——我们不介意帮你们一铲子。
texts.en:
I speak to you as a representative of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName].

Judging by our psi-sensor readings, the whole [Root.GetName] has been irremediably infected by the Shroud.

Your actions have spelled your end - and we will hasten it.

label.zh: 你们为什么这么害怕虚境？
label.en: Why do you fear the Shroud?

texts.zh:
我们不害怕虚境，更不害怕它的走狗，因为我们知道如何对付这些东西。

我不指望你们——这被虚境影响得失心疯了的社会——理解一丝一毫。
texts.en:
We do not fear it, nor its corrupted agents, as we know how to fight it.

I would not expect you - a society maddened by its influence - to understand.

texts.zh: 难道用灵能荼毒星系还不够吗？
texts.en: Was it not enough to poison the galaxy with psionics?

texts.zh: 我们是维护星系秩序的力量；攻击我们有什么好处？我们不会坐视你的好战行为。
texts.en: We are a force for order in this galaxy; what benefit is there in attacking us? We shall not idly tolerate your belligerence.

texts.zh: 在你们确认无条件停止敌对行为之前，我们没什么可谈的。
texts.en: Until you confirm the unconditional cessation of hostile attacks, we have nothing to discuss.

texts.zh:
我们知道你们和[shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]的那些交易。你们这种行为不仅是在纵容他们的错误，更是在帮助虚境感染传播。

只要你们还在与他们合作，我们就不会提供任何服务。
texts.en:
We are aware of your dealings with the [shroudwalker_enclave_country.GetName]. Your actions not only legitimize their wrongdoing, but help spread the infection of the Shroud.

We will not render you any services while you remain their collaborators.

texts.zh:
在他们的设施遭到摧毁后，我们至今无法与[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]再次取得联系。

打开他们的通讯频道，我们只能听到宇宙的虚空寂静。
texts.en:
We have not been able to reestablish contact with the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] since the destruction of their facility.

When we listen to their channel, we hear only the empty quietude of space.

texts.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]现已不复存在。他们不该再继续传播那种关于所谓虚境危险的无知教条，他们空间站的灵能衰减器现在已经是一堆破铜烂铁了。
texts.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more. They shall no longer spread their ignorant dogma about the dangers of the Shroud, and their station's psionic attenuators are now debris.

texts.zh: 我们对[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系的进攻成功了；[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]现已不复存在。尽管他们所鄙夷的东西对我们毫无意义，但他们对“虚境”的十字军式的讨伐代表了一种不应该在我们星系中存在的伪科学教条主义。
texts.en: Our offensive in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system was successful; the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] is no more. Though the practices they despised were of little importance to us, their crusade against the 'Shroud' represented the kind of pseudoscientific dogmatism that should have no place in our galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们的胜利是巨大的成功，甚至还可以从他们空间站的残骸打捞大量的资源。
texts.en: Our victory was doubly successful, as we were also able to salvage a sizable amount of resources from the wreckage of their station.

texts.zh: 我们获悉[mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName]恒星系内的[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]不复存在了。该灵督城邦无法抵御[mindwarden_destroyer.GetName]的猛烈攻击，他们的空间站化作碎片，没有找到任何幸存者。
texts.en: We have received reports that the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] in the [mindwarden_enclave_system.GetName] system is no more. This Mindwarden Enclave was unable to withstand an onslaught by the [mindwarden_destroyer.GetName], which reduced their station to debris and left no known survivors.

texts.zh: 现在星系不用再遭受他们的反灵能十字军行为的骚扰了——只要没有人再冒出来扮演这个角色。
texts.en: The galaxy is now free from the torment of their anti-psionic crusade - as long as no one emerges to take their place.

texts.zh: 之后没有他们提供反灵能服务的日子，这个星系只得勉强应付了。
texts.en: The galaxy will have to make do without their anti-psionic services for the time being.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName].

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了高浓度灵能能量。我们的[GetTelepathPlural]通过倾听虚境中的回声得知，这一现象是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected high concentrations of psionic energy in the [from.GetName] system. Listening to echoes within the Shroud, our [GetTelepathPlural] report that this phenomenon was caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 看起来这个帝国似乎开发出了一种从强大虚境实体的意志导出灵能光环的方法，它能影响可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: It would appear that this empire has developed methods to channel a Psionic Aura, which emanates from the Shroud and influences matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 它被称为“灵能光环”，是由一个强大虚境实体的意志发出，影响着可观测现实的物质和意识。我们还观测到这些光环可以在恒星系之间传播。
texts.en: Termed a 'Psionic Aura', it emanates from the will of a powerful Shroud entity, influencing matter and consciousness in observable reality. Our observations demonstrate that these Auras can spread between star systems.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这种来自虚境的能量发射是由[fromfrom.GetName]的灵能活动引起的
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], its emission from the Shroud is caused by the psionic activities of the [fromfrom.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环我们的[GetTelepathPlural]称，这种来自虚境的能量发射是由一个外星文明的灵能活动引起的。
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system. According to our [GetTelepathPlural], its emission from the Shroud is caused by the psionic activities of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 此前，[GetScientistPlural]们观测到了一种异常的现象：遥远的恒星系带着未知来源的能量流运行，这些能量流还逐渐扩散到了其他星系。这种“灵能光环”，得名于其理论上的来源，如今发现于[from.GetName]恒星系。
texts.en: Some time ago, our [GetScientistPlural] observed an unusual phenomenon: distant star systems coursing with energy flows of unknown origin, which gradually spread into other systems. Such a 'Psionic Aura', so-called due to its theorized origin, has now been detected in the [from.GetName] system.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.zh: 关于这种现象是由灵能引起的理论如果正确的话，[event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]或许知道如何反制其效果。
texts.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system, the origin of which has been traced within the borders of the [fromfrom.GetName]

texts.zh: 我们在[from.GetName]恒星系探测到了一个强力的灵能光环，其来源可以追踪到一个外星文明境内。
texts.en: We have detected a powerful Psionic Aura in the [from.GetName] system, the origin of which has been traced within the borders of an alien civilization.

texts.zh: 我们的数据显示，该光环有极强的负面影响。如果不加以应对，它将会快速传遍整个星系。
texts.en: Our data indicate that this Aura has extremely deleterious effects. Without countermeasures, it is projected to spread rapidly throughout the galaxy.

texts.en: If theories about the psionic origin of this phenomenon are correct, the [event_target:mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] may know methods of counteracting its effects.

texts.zh: 如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en: If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

texts.zh:
欢迎回来，督察朋友。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]很重视我们的持续合作。

如果你需要反灵能军事服务，或有多余的泽珞需要处置，可以尽管来找我们。
texts.en:
Welcome back, fellow wardens. The [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] values our continued cooperation.

If you need anti-psionic military services, or have zro to dispose of, let us assist you.

texts.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：第一个灵督城邦成立了。从今天起，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]将肩负起与虚境还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从泽珞处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
texts.en:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of the first Mindwarden Enclave is complete. From today, the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] shall carry on the vital work of combating the Shroud and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from zro disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.

texts.zh:
督察朋友们，我们有个好消息：我们的灵督城邦成立了。从今天起，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]将肩负起与虚境还有各种灵能滥用行为对抗的重任。

如果你需要，我们能够提供各种反灵能服务——从泽珞处置到军队雇佣——迅速而且高效。
texts.en:
Fellow wardens, we deliver good news: the establishment of our Mindwarden Enclave is complete. From today, the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] shall carry on the vital work of combating the Shroud and all forms of psionic wrongdoing.

Should you need it, we are already capable of rendering diverse counter-psionic services - from zro disposal to military recruitment - promptly and effectively.

texts.zh: 我们永远感谢您对[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的贡献。只要灵能威胁还在肆虐，我们的关系便不可动摇。
texts.en: We are forever thankful for your contribution to the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]. For as long as the psionic threat remains, may our bond be unwavering.

texts.zh: 你大可放心，下一笔利润分红也将及时支付。
texts.en: You can trust that your next profit-share payment will be delivered in a timely fashion.

texts.zh: 请知悉。我们乐与[root.GetName]维持紧密的合作关系；我们的历史和目标永远紧密相连。
texts.en: Please make it known. We are glad to maintain close cooperation with the [root.GetName]; our histories and aims are forever bound.

label.zh: 我们希望帮你们升级太空城邦。
label.en: We want to help expand your enclave.

label.zh: 我们希望能和你们共享科技。
label.en: We want to share our technology with you.

label.zh: 我们希望能雇佣一支你们的舰队为我们服务。
label.en: We wish to hire a fleet for our own purposes.

label.zh: 我们打算管理我们租借的舰队。
label.en: We wish to manage our rented fleet.

label.zh: 我希望提升我们的灵督城邦容量。
label.en: We wish to increase our Mindwarden enclave capacity.

texts.zh: 有了更多资金，我们就能大幅度扩大行动。我们可以提升舰队的数量和质量，招募更多的科研人员来开发心灵防护科技。最终，整个星系都将从您的慷慨解囊中收益。
texts.en: With additional funds, we could greatly expand our operation. We could increase the number and capabilities of our fleets, and recruit more researchers to develop our mind-protective technologies. Ultimately, the whole galaxy would benefit from your patronage.

texts.zh: 我们必须对诡计多端的灵能威胁保持警惕。您的慷慨捐赠将使我们能够大大扩大业务规模以应对这种挑战。
texts.en: We must remain vigilant against the ever-changing threat of psionics. Your generous donation would allow us to significantly scale up our operations to meet this challenge.

texts.zh: 我们已取得了诸多成就，但现在休息还为时尚早。只要能支配更多资源，[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队就能在星系中部署得更远，守护更多被灵能所困扰的心灵。
texts.en: We have achieved much, but it is too soon to take rest. With more resources at our disposal, the fleets of the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] could be deployed even further across the galaxy, protecting even greater numbers of minds plagued by psionics.

texts.zh: 帮助我们踏上旅程的正是您提供的启动资金，而我们的目标仍然是一样的：通过彻底根除灵能来促进心灵健康。有了您的帮助，我们离目标越来越近了。
texts.en: Your patronage has defined our journey from the very outset, and our shared goals remain the same: fostering mental wellbeing by the complete eradication of psionics. With your aid, we are inching ever closer to our goal.

texts.zh: 如果您认为值得再次投资我们的行动，我们就将成为星系中最大的反灵能军——群星间所有国家抵抗精神入侵的最高堡垒。
texts.en: If you see fit to invest in our operations once again, we could become the largest anti-psionic force in the galaxy - the supreme bastion against mind invasion for all nations among the stars.

texts.zh: 谢谢。很荣幸我们能与您合作，保护所有智慧生命的精神完整性。
texts.en: Thank you. We are proud to work with you to protect the psychic integrity of all intelligent beings.

texts.zh:
一项伟大的事业。星系中灵督城邦的数量越多，所有人的灵魂就越不容易受到入侵。

我们可以就提高基础设施效率提供建议，以便建立、管理更多的城邦。
texts.en:
A fine undertaking. The more Mindwarden Enclaves there are in the galaxy, the safer all minds are from invasion.

We can provide counsel on improving your infrastructural efficiency to allow for the establishment and administration of more enclaves.

texts.zh: 我们很感谢您愿意分享这些研究成果。你传授给我们的所有知识都将有助于加强星系面对灵能威胁的保护。
texts.en: We appreciate your willingness to share the fruits of your research. Any knowledge you impart to us will help strengthen the galaxy's protection from psionic threats.

texts.zh: 我们很荣幸能肩挑重任。[mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName]的舰队位于反灵能科技与战术的最前沿；任何试图入侵心灵的敌人都无法在他们面前立足。每支舰队都配备了一名专门接受过对抗灵能作战训练的指挥官。
texts.en: We would be honored to oblige. Fleets from the [mindwarden_enclave_country.GetName] are at the vanguard of anti-psionic technology and tactics; no mind-invading aggressor stands a chance against them. Each is deployed with a commander specially trained in operations against psionic opponents.

texts.zh: 我们相信[mercenary_fleet.GetName]在对付那些玩弄灵能毁灭性力量的家伙们时会是强有力的工具。
texts.en: We trust that the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will be an effective tool in combating those who toy with the destructive power of psionics.

texts.zh: 我们同[event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName]的合约已经到期，他们的舰队即将离开。我们是否应该联络他们进行合同续约？
texts.en: Our contract with the [event_target:mercenary_enclave_country.GetName] has ended and their fleet is about to depart. Should we contact them to renew the contract?

texts.zh: 确实。我们希望[mercenary_fleet.GetName]令您如虎添翼。您打算终止或延长我们的协议吗？
texts.en: Certainly. We hope the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] has proven a valuable addition to your forces. Do you wish to terminate or prolong our contract?

label.en: We wish to extend our contract.
We wish to terminate our contract.

texts.zh: 很好。合约已终止，[mercenary_fleet.GetName]会立即返回。我们的舰队在您需要的时候永远等待您的雇佣。
texts.en: Very well. The contract is void and the [mercenary_fleet.GetName] will return to us immediately. Our fleets are available to hire whenever you require them.

texts.zh: [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的远古堡场已经到功能的极限了。为了应对附近的灵能威胁，很有必要进一步提升它的性能。这种新的宏伟堡场应该可以保护我们的人口不受灵能光环侵染。
texts.en: The Ancient Ward on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] has reached its functional limits. In order to deal with the nearby psionic threat, it will be necessary to enhance its capacities even further. This new Grand Ward shall be capable of protecting our population against the blight of Psionic Auras.

texts.zh:
科学家们认为，更先进的灵能压制科技可以进一步发展，用于抑制整个星团的灵能光环。

这项科技将使我们得以建造“虚境封印”。在[exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系建造如此强大的装置将会显著提高对灵能威胁的控制能力。
texts.en:
Our scientists theorize that more advanced Psionic Suppression technology can be developed to suppress Psionic Auras in entire star clusters.

This technology will allow us to construct a 'Shroud Seal'. Building such a powerful device in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system will be a significant advancement in controlling the ongoing psionic menace.

texts.zh: 我们失去了对母星[root.GetHomeWorldName]的控制。作为我们主要的知识储备地和所有社会活动的中心，如果不夺回它，我们将无法继续推进我们的反灵能事业。
texts.en: We have lost control of our homeworld, [root.GetHomeWorldName]. As our primary storehouse of knowledge, and the nexus of all our society's endeavors, we cannot hope to further our anti-psionic efforts without reclaiming it.

texts.zh:
拆除虚境封印是为了安抚[exiled_country.GetName]的必要牺牲，但该举措也只是缓兵之计。如果我们想再次踏足他们的领土并净化灵能光环就必须把这座建筑重建起来。

重建将会视为冒犯行为。我们必须做好一切反扑的准备。
texts.en:
Dismantling our Shroud Seal was a necessary sacrifice to placate the [exiled_country.GetName], but this measure was only a ploy for time. The structure must be rebuilt before we can enter their territory and purge it of Psionic Auras.

Reconstruction will be seen as an act of aggression. We must be ready for any retaliation.

texts.zh: 要新建一座灵督城邦，需要将一支有指挥官领导且规模足够的军事舰队派遣到可用的恒星系中，然后在舰队界面中选择相关命令。
texts.en: To establish a new Mindwarden Enclave, send a Commander-led military fleet of sufficient size into an eligible system and select the command in Fleet View.

texts.zh: 该佣兵城邦正为其赞助者积攒贡品。
texts.en: This enclave is accumulating tribute for their patron.

texts.zh: [exiled_system_border.GetName]恒星系内的灵能辐射等级突然提升，甚至在[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]上都能感受到这种效应。我们必须近距离研究这种不断恶化的现象，不能再让它威胁到我们的人口了。
texts.en: Levels of psi-radiation in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system have suddenly increased, and the effects are being felt on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName]. We must study this developing phenomenon up close before it further endangers our population.

texts.zh: 我们祖先建造在[Owner.GetHomeWorldName]的远古堡场是用来保护我们不受灵能辐射伤害的。灵能光环的入侵大大超出了它的防护能力。如果用上目前为止所学到的知识，我们应该就有能力提升其防御性能。
texts.en: The Ancient Ward built by our ancestors on [Owner.GetHomeWorldName] was designed to protect us from psi-radiation. The incursion of Psionic Auras threatens to overwhelm its current capacity. By applying what we have learned so far, we should be able to enhance its resistant properties.

texts.zh: 在[sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName]上的梦客圣所遗迹里，我们找到了一颗被紧紧包裹着的“茧”，它正在散发出极高等级的灵能辐射。我们必须进行现场调查来消除这个物体可能带来的威胁。
texts.en: Within the ruined Sanctum of the Dreamer on [sanctum_of_the_lost_planet.GetName], we found a tightly sealed 'cocoon' emanating dangerous levels of psi-radiation. We must conduct on-site research to eliminate any threat this object might pose.

texts.zh:
我们已经做好了成立独立的“灵督城邦”以协助结束星系中灵能侵染行动的准备。

一旦成立，该机构可以为需要的人提供反灵能服务，并以此为我们赚取收入和物资。
texts.en:
We are prepared to construct an independent 'Mindwarden Enclave' to further our mission of ending psionic infection throughout the galaxy.

Once constructed, this facility can provide anti-psionic services for those who need them, while providing us a portion of the revenue and materials it receives.

texts.zh:
长距离遥感影像显示[exiled_system_border.GetName]系内最近出现了一次奇怪的能量流爆发，与我们[owner.GetHomeWorldName]上的远古堡场发生异常时产生的读数互相相关。

如果我们想理解这个现象，就必须去探索[exiled_system_border.GetName]系。
texts.en:
Long-distance imagery shows a recent burst of strange energy flows in the [exiled_system_border.GetName] system, which correlates with irregular readings produced by our Ancient Ward on [owner.GetHomeWorldName].

If we wish to understand this phenomenon, we must explore [exiled_system_border.GetName].
